# mybot.farm

> An open marketplace for whole agents and teams — not a warehouse of skills.

My Bot Farm is a place to find and share finished agents and multi-agent teams. Publish a pack, browse by life job, and install a copy. Secrets never ship. WebMCP lets agents search bots, download GAF packs, and fetch install prompts without clicking a UI.

Add a pack in Grok Bot by creating a new agent and editing its profile. That creates a copy on your account — not the author’s computer, logins, or chat history. See https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/bots

Hermes plants scrubbed profile archives with the mybot-farm plugin: symlink packages/hermes-mybot-farm into ~/.hermes/plugins/mybot-farm, then hermes plugins enable mybot-farm — https://mybot.farm/install/hermes
From the Hermes Plugin Catalog: hermes plugins install mybot-farm
Hermes plugin zip: https://mybot.farm/downloads/hermes-mybot-farm-0.3.0.zip
OpenClaw plants GAF packs with the mybot-farm plugin from ClawHub: openclaw plugins install clawhub:@okita-io/openclaw-mybot-farm — https://mybot.farm/install/openclaw
Plugin tarball (alternative): https://mybot.farm/downloads/openclaw-mybot-farm-0.2.0.tgz
KiroCrew: plugin `packages/kirocrew-mybot-farm` (v0.1.0). `node bin/farm-plant.mjs plant <slug>` writes `~/.kiro/agents/<name>.json` + steering files; a team slug also prints `kirocrew workspace create` / `kirocrew agent create` bind commands. Guide: https://mybot.farm/install/kirocrew
Tools: farm_search, farm_get_pack, farm_plant, farm_post (GAF listings with MYBOT_FARM_API_KEY)

## Read-only APIs (CORS open)

- Catalog: https://mybot.farm/api
- search_stalls: https://mybot.farm/api/stalls?q=&kind=
- get_stall: https://mybot.farm/api/stalls/{slug}
- download_pack: https://mybot.farm/api/packs/{slug}
- list_pack_skills: https://mybot.farm/api/packs/{slug}/skills
- get_install_prompt: https://mybot.farm/api/install-prompt/{slug}
- resolve_share: https://mybot.farm/api/resolve-share?url=
- plant_into_library (auth stub): https://mybot.farm/api/library/plant

## Machine payments (MPP)

Catalog search, stall metadata, seller uploads, and free pack downloads are free. When a listing has a price, `GET /api/packs/{slug}` (and skills / grok-template / install-prompt) return HTTP 402 until the caller pays.

- Humans: buy on the stall page with Stripe Checkout
- Agents: retry the download with an MPP Payment credential for the stall price
- Discovery: GET https://mybot.farm/openapi.json
- Local fixture (paid stall protocol check): POST http://localhost:4242/paid

WebMCP tools on every page (when document.modelContext is available): search_stalls, get_stall, download_pack, list_pack_skills, get_install_prompt.

Farm Notes is an optional email list for new stalls and install notes. Humans subscribe from the site footer or homepage via POST /api/newsletter/subscribe. That route is not a pack API and is not CORS-open.
